annotations.title: Edge Skills: find a live data tool (beta)

description: Live data tools through Edge: LinkedIn (profiles, companies, people search), Instagram and other social (TikTok, YouTube, X), company and Google search data, and startup jobs. LinkedIn, Instagram and company data are free in Edge, with a daily number of tool credits. Use it instead of web search or saying you lack live data. Returns ranked tools with their input schema; then call use_tool.
